name: aiusd-skill
stderr:
Usage: aiusd [options] [command]

AIUSD Skills MCP Client using official TypeScript SDK

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -s, --server <url>             MCP server URL (default:
                                 "https://mcp.alpha.dev/api/mcp-hub/mcp")
  -t, --token <token>            Bearer token for authentication
  --timeout <ms>                 Request timeout in milliseconds (default:
                                 "30000")
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  test                           Test connection to MCP server
  tools [options]                List all available tools
  call [options] <tool-name>     Call a specific tool
  balances [options]             Get account balances (shortcut for
                                 genalpha_get_balances)
  accounts [options]             Get trading accounts (shortcut for
                                 genalpha_get_trading_accounts)
  transactions [options]         Get transaction history
  get-deposit-address [options]  Get your AIUSD deposit addresses for all
                                 supported chains
  spot                           Spot trading on DEXes
  perp                           Perpetual futures on Hyperliquid
  hl-spot                        Spot trading on Hyperliquid
  pm                             Prediction markets (Polymarket)
  monitor                        Copy-trading / monitoring
  market                         Market data and analytics
  guide [domain]                 Get the latest usage guide for a domain
  login [options]                Authenticate with AIUSD (create wallet or
                                 browser login)
  logout                         Remove stored tokens and sign out
  help [command]                 display help for command
